description:
Aggregate the work that delivers this outcome: the default suite runs no nested cargo build or tool-skipping test, fixtures are keyed on inputs, and footprint and clock are reported.

## Background

This story groups the test-topology tasks that share one design surface, so they can be reviewed together once each has landed.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A test whose tool is missing fails, the default suite runs no nested cargo build, and shell-script self-tests run as declared gates.
- [hard] REQ-02: The profiled-repository fixture is reused under a key derived only from its inputs, the product binary has no hidden fixture subcommand, and no test-runner configuration lists individual test names.
- [hard] REQ-03: The build-footprint budget checker passes, and integration-target count and active test-executable bytes are reported before and after.
- [hard] REQ-04: The cargo-ci suite clock is reported before and after, and no test in the default suite exceeds 5 s on a warm target at load ≤ 10.
title: The default suite runs within its time and footprint budgets
